A global gaming studio (live-service title, 15M MAU): a Technology & SaaS program run on the outcome-linked model with a blended Dataq Software team. The name stays behind the NDA; the numbers are published with permission.
Player telemetry rich but decision loops slow; content bets anecdotal.
Live-ops manual; teams firefighting events. Launch/patch peaks crashed cost and reliability models.

The player-intelligence platform unified telemetry with decision lineage feeding content and economy teams; live-ops orchestration automated events and balancing with human signoff; peak engineering (load/chaos) stabilized launches; and integrity detection scaled against cheating economies.
Outcomes, as the client reported them

blocks.caption: Measured outcomes
rows: zero launch outages across two seasons

blocks.x: What the success is actually made of

items: one governed definition per metric ended the metric disputes before the build scaled.
evaluation was an engineering artifact, not a slide: the models earned production by passing a set the client's reviewers recognized as their own.
the platform work made scaling boring, which is the highest compliment infrastructure can earn.

blocks.x: If you are considering the same pattern

What transferred directly from the global gaming studio (live-service title, 15M MAU) program: the decision pattern and the evidence design. What never transfers: the estate's quirks — which is why every program re-runs the baseline diagnostic on its own data before any build The engagement model here was build-run; the same pattern runs fixed-scope where the estate allows it.
Figures on this page are the client's, reproduced with permission. Method notes and measurement designs are available under NDA.
